outcome.answer: The closest matches are [1], [3], [6], and [9]. [1] and [9] describe hierarchical tree-based retrieval for long documents, using chunk trees or summary trees to connect queries to relevant chunks. [3] also builds a hierarchical tree over chunks and uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, which helps capture multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. [6] is more about exploring corpora with evidence-grounded hierarchical topic maps, linking documents to topics through supporting spans rather than retrieval for QA.
